# GitHub Copilot Instructions

Follow `AGENTS.md` in the repository root. It contains the non-negotiable rules for this project and an index of every development policy. The files in `policies/` are the source of truth; if this file and `policies/` disagree, `policies/` wins.

<!-- PROJECT-VIC-POLICY:START -->
<!-- Generated by scripts/sync_agent_rules.py from policies/. Do not edit between these markers. -->

Before every task, read these core policies:

- `policies/rule-index.md`: Index, precedence, and shared data taxonomy for the Project VIC development policies in this repository
- `policies/human-review-and-risk-gates.md`: Require explicit human review for high-risk changes before merge, release, or irreversible actions
- `policies/no-stubs.md`: No stubs - implement real functionality with tested behavior and actionable failures
- `policies/privacy-redaction-and-synthetic-data.md`: Privacy, redaction, and tiered test data; channel safety for anything that could carry sensitive data into prompts, commits, CI, issues, docs, screenshots, logs, or benchmarks
- `policies/project-context.md`: Repository-local project context (stack, surfaces, commands) to be adapted after the first intake is complete
- `policies/security-compliance.md`: Security, privacy, jurisdiction-aware compliance, and forensic evidence handling requirements for mission tools
- `policies/speckit-workflow.md`: Mandatory Spec Kit workflow for feature development, non-trivial fixes, and release-relevant changes
- `policies/student-mode.md`: Beginner-safe pacing, explanations, and approval gates for students and new developers using this template

Read the matching conditional policy listed in `AGENTS.md` before working in its area.
<!-- PROJECT-VIC-POLICY:END -->
